title: EoS AI capability registry
description: Curated vocabulary of AI capabilities an app may declare in data/apps.json `ai_capabilities` (Track 1: app manifests -> install-time permission model). FAIL-CLOSED: a capability name not listed here is rejected by scripts/validate_apps.py. Capability names are dotted; access levels are none/read/write/readwrite. `default_access` is the level granted at install with no user decision - a default of "none" means the installer must prompt the user before anything flows (see docs/ai-capability-permissions.md).

capabilities.description: Capability name -> registry entry. Only these names are valid.

camera_frames.description: Frames from the device camera (vision input: stills, video, depth where available).

mic_frames.description: Audio frames from the device microphone (voice input, ambient audio).

speaker_frames.description: Audio rendered through the device speaker (TTS, alerts, playback).

inference.local.description: On-device model inference (compute only; no data leaves the device). read = run inference over data the app may already access; write = install/persist models on device; readwrite = both.

inference.cloud.description: Off-device (cloud) model inference. Any use sends app data off the device, so explicit user consent is always required. read = submit jobs and receive results; write = fine-tune/train remote models with app data; readwrite = both.

npu.description: Direct access to the on-device neural accelerator (Track-1 accelerator HAL tier target). read = submit workloads; write = manage accelerator partitions/firmware; readwrite = both.

location.description: Device location (GNSS, network, or fused fixes). Personal data; explicit user consent is always required.

contacts.description: Access to the device contacts/people graph. Personal data; explicit user consent is always required.
